app_phase.mapping: lockscreen=true => foreground/background boundary is background; otherwise foreground

background_restricted.mapping: only report true when an explicit device-idle or battery-optimization signal is observed; otherwise keep false and record this as not testable on the device

display_state.mapping: screen_on = mHoldingDisplaySuspendBlocker=true or state=ON in power; lockscreen is distinguished separately from display state

network_kind.mapping: require active-network evidence (TRANSPORT_WIFI or interface wlan + inet) before classifying wifi; require active transport evidence before classifying cellular
